canonical_statement: For every first-order language L and L-theory T, T has a nonempty model if and only if every finite subtheory of T has a nonempty model.

canonical_formal_target.type: forall {L : FirstOrder.Language.{u,v}} {T : L.Theory}, T.IsSatisfiable iff T.IsFinitelySatisfiable

checked_encodings.finite_set_transport: finiteSet_iff_finset proves equivalence between finite Set subtheories and mathlib's Finset encoding

mutations_killed: moved the theory binder across the iff
degenerate_cases: The empty language, empty theory, and empty finite subtheory are included; no countability or finiteness assumption is imposed on L or T.
